zh-CN.title: Apple Intelligence 时代：现代 App Intents 架构改造与 Spotlight 联动
zh-CN.description: 从旧版 SiriKit 痛点出发，深入解析现代化 App Intents 框架的实体建模（AppEntity）、语义检索（EntityQuery）与零样本动作路由机制，重构面向 Apple Intelligence 的系统级接入层。
zh-CN.content:
TL;DR：随着 Apple Intelligence 在 iOS 18 及后续系统中的全面落地，Siri 与系统的语义入口发生了代际变革。过去基于 .intentdefinition 图形化文件的 SiriKit 时代彻底谢幕，取而代之的是纯 Swift 代码声明、强类型编译期校验的 App Intents 框架。App 不再只是一个等待用户手动点击打开的孤岛，而是通过暴露 AppEntity 与 AppIntent，成为系统级智能调度的分布式能力单元。本文分享如何对既有工程进行现代化改造，实现丝滑的 Spotlight 与自然语言意图直达。

一、 为什么旧版 SiriKit 无法支撑现代 AI 体验？

在旧版 SiriKit 架构下，开发者必须在 Xcode 里维护一个沉重的 .intentdefinition XML 配置文件，系统仅支持预设的十几个固定领域（如 VoIP 通话、打车、发消息）：

  1. 类型安全性脆弱：生成的 Objective-C/Swift 桥接代码充斥着隐式解包可选型（IUO），一旦模型参数不匹配容易崩溃。
  2. 缺乏状态感知力：系统无法获知 App 当前内部的数据实体（如文档、音频片段、订单列表）具体有哪些，无法支持诸如“打开上周二李工发我的那份采购合同”等上下文模糊查询。
  3. 维护成本极高：每次新增动作都要跨多层文件同步，与现代 Swift 并发及声明式架构格格不入。

二、 现代核心模型：AppEntity 与 EntityQuery

现代架构的核心基石是将 App 内部的业务模型，抽象投影为符合系统契约的 AppEntity：

flowchart LR
    subgraph App_Domain["App 领域实体"]
        Model[ProjectDocument 业务模型]
    end

    subgraph Entity_Bridge["App Intents 抽象层"]
        Entity[AppEntity 协议实现]
        Query[EntityQuery 语义查询提供者]
        Intent[OpenDocumentIntent 动作]
    end

    subgraph System_Surfaces["Apple Intelligence 系统级入口"]
        Siri[Siri 自然语言理解]
        Spotlight[Spotlight 语义索引搜索]
        Shortcuts[快捷指令自动化]
    end

    Model --> Entity
    Entity --> Query
    Query --> System_Surfaces
    System_Surfaces --> Intent
    Intent -->|触发执行| Model

import AppIntents
import CoreSpotlight

// 1. 业务实体声明
public struct ProjectDocumentEntity: AppEntity {
  public static var defaultQuery = ProjectDocumentQuery()

  public static var typeDisplayRepresentation: TypeDisplayRepresentation = "工程设计文档"

  public var id: UUID
  
  @Property(title: "文档标题")
  public var title: String

  @Property(title: "最后修改时间")
  public var lastModifiedDate: Date

  public var displayRepresentation: DisplayRepresentation {
    DisplayRepresentation(
      title: "\(title)",
      subtitle: "修改于 \(lastModifiedDate.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened))"
    )
  }
}

// 2. 实体查询检索器（支持系统高效检索）
public struct ProjectDocumentQuery: EntityQuery {
  public init() {}

  // 根据系统传入的 ID 批量获取实体
  public func entities(for identifiers: [UUID]) async throws -> [ProjectDocumentEntity] {
    let storage = await DocumentDatabase.shared
    return try await storage.fetchDocuments(with: identifiers).map { $0.toEntity() }
  }

  // 供 Spotlight 和 Siri 在用户输入模糊关键词时调用
  public func suggestedEntities() async throws -> [ProjectDocumentEntity] {
    let storage = await DocumentDatabase.shared
    return try await storage.fetchRecentDocuments(limit: 5).map { $0.toEntity() }
  }
}

三、 零样本动作：实现可组合的 AppIntent

定义好数据实体后，执行具体动作的 AppIntent 变得极其简洁而确定：

public struct ExportDocumentAsPDFIntent: AppIntent {
  public static var title: LocalizedStringResource = "将文档导出为 PDF"
  public static var description = IntentDescription("将选定的工程设计文档渲染并导出为高保真 PDF 文件")

  // 系统会自动通过 ProjectDocumentQuery 解析用户提及的实体
  @Parameter(title: "目标文档")
  public var targetDocument: ProjectDocumentEntity

  @Parameter(title: "包含附件批注", default: true)
  public var includeAnnotations: Bool

  public init() {}

  @MainActor
  public func perform() async throws -> some ReturnsValue<URL> & ShowsSnippetView {
    // 1. 获取底层真实数据
    let doc = try await DocumentDatabase.shared.find(targetDocument.id)
    
    // 2. 执行核心渲染导出
    let pdfUrl = try await PDFExportEngine.render(document: doc, includeAnnotations: includeAnnotations)
    
    // 3. 返回执行结果并展示原生交互卡片
    return .result(
      value: pdfUrl,
      view: DocumentExportPreviewCard(document: doc, pdfUrl: pdfUrl)
    )
  }
}

四、 性能门禁与内存纪律

Apple Intelligence 对 Intent 的执行有着极其严苛的物理限制：

  1. 响应时间门禁（$\le 500 ext{ ms}$）：如果 perform() 方法在 500ms 内没有完成初始化或返回异步句柄，系统会判定 App 无响应并向用户报出超时错误。因此耗时的重型计算必须立即将任务移交至后台 Worker。
  2. 内存上限（$30 ext{ MB}$ 约束）：当 Intent 作为独立的 App Extension 进程拉起时，系统为其分配的 Jetsam 内存上限极低，严禁在 Extension 内一次性解码超大原始图像。

五、 架构演进总结

App Intents 不仅是 Siri 的外挂，更是现代 iOS 应用模块化解耦的终极推手。将核心业务逻辑收敛为一个个纯粹、独立的 Intent 和 Entity，不仅让应用在系统级智能交互中占据先机，更让工程本身的单元测试与架构边界获得了前所未有的清晰度。

  • Swift 6 严格并发检查下的数据隔离与 Sendable 实战陷阱
  • Swift Testing 深度实践：从 XCTest 迁移到现代化宏断言体系

en.title: The Apple Intelligence Era: Modern App Intents Architecture Transformation and Spotlight Integration
en.description: Starting with the pain points of the old SiriKit, this paper delves into the entity modeling (AppEntity), semantic retrieval (EntityQuery), and zero-shot action routing mechanism of the modern App Intents framework, and reconstructs the system-level access layer for Apple Intelligence.
en.content:
TL;DRWith the full implementation of Apple Intelligence in iOS 18 and later systems, Siri and the system's semantic entry point have undergone a generational transformation. Previously based on....intentdefinitionThe era of SiriKit with graphical documentation has come to a complete end, replaced by pure Swift code declarations and strongly typed compile-time checks.App IntentsFramework. The app is no longer just an isolated island waiting for the user to manually open it, but rather...AppEntity and AppIntentThis transforms existing engineering projects into distributed capability units for system-level intelligent scheduling. This article shares how to modernize existing projects to achieve seamless Spotlight and direct access to natural language intent.

1. Why can't the old version of SiriKit support modern AI experiences?

In the old SiriKit architecture, developers had to maintain a heavy....intentdefinitionThe XML configuration file only supports a dozen or so preset fixed domains (such as VoIP calls, ride-hailing, and messaging):

  1. Type security is fragileThe generated Objective-C/Swift bridging code is riddled with implicit unpacked optionals (IUO), which can easily cause crashes if the model parameters do not match.
  2. Lack of state awarenessThe system cannot determine the specific data entities (such as documents, audio clips, and order lists) currently within the App, and cannot support contextual fuzzy queries such as "open the purchase contract that Mr. Li sent me last Tuesday".
  3. Extremely high maintenance costsEach new action requires synchronization across multiple file layers, which is incompatible with modern Swift concurrency and declarative architecture.

II. Modern Core Models: AppEntity and EntityQuery

The core foundation of modern architecture is to abstract and project the business model within an app into a form that conforms to the system contract.AppEntity：

flowchart LR
    subgraph App_Domain["App 领域实体"]
        Model[ProjectDocument 业务模型]
    end

    subgraph Entity_Bridge["App Intents 抽象层"]
        Entity[AppEntity 协议实现]
        Query[EntityQuery 语义查询提供者]
        Intent[OpenDocumentIntent 动作]
    end

    subgraph System_Surfaces["Apple Intelligence 系统级入口"]
        Siri[Siri 自然语言理解]
        Spotlight[Spotlight 语义索引搜索]
        Shortcuts[快捷指令自动化]
    end

    Model --> Entity
    Entity --> Query
    Query --> System_Surfaces
    System_Surfaces --> Intent
    Intent -->|触发执行| Model

IV. Performance Gating and Memory Discipline

Apple Intelligence imposes extremely strict physical limitations on the execution of Intents:

  1. Response time access control ($\le 500 ext{ ms}$):if perform()If a method fails to complete initialization or return an asynchronous handle within 500ms, the system will determine that the app is unresponsive and report a timeout error to the user. Therefore, time-consuming, heavy computations must be immediately handed over to a background worker.
  2. Memory limit ($30 ext{ MB}$ constraint)When an Intent is launched as a separate App Extension process, the system allocates a very low maximum amount of Jetsam memory to it. Decoding extremely large raw images all at once within an Extension is strictly prohibited.

V. Summary of Architecture Evolution

App Intents are not just a plugin for Siri, but also...The ultimate driving force behind modular decoupling in modern iOS applicationsBy converging core business logic into pure, independent Intents and Entities, applications not only gain an advantage in system-level intelligent interactions, but also achieve unprecedented clarity in unit testing and architectural boundaries.
